He is considered one of the greatest rulers in the history of Kievan Rus'. Jaroslav is credited with the establishment of a golden age in Kievan Rus', during which the lands were at peace, commerce flourished, and culture and learning advanced.

Blessed Jaroslav, Prince of Ostrava and Opava, is a Blessed of the Catholic Church, having been beatified by the Holy See in 1995.
